definitions.explanation: Finely chopped or sliced green onions used as a garnish or topping on Japanese dishes such as ramen, udon, miso soup, and tofu.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻|きざ}み{葱|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる。
examples.english: To put chopped green onions on ramen.

examples.japanese: {刻|きざ}み{葱|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please add plenty of chopped green onions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷奴|ひややっこ}→冷奴：27679_hiyayakko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻|きざ}み{葱|ねぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせて⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat cold tofu with chopped green onions and ginger on top.

notes:
One of the most common garnishes (⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧) in Japanese cooking. ⟦{刻|きざ}む→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧ means 'to chop finely,' so {刻|きざ}み{葱|ねぎ} literally means 'chopped green onion.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Topping for ramen, udon, soba, and ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧
- Garnish on ⟦{冷奴|ひややっこ}→冷奴：27679_hiyayakko⟧ (cold tofu) and ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧
- Added to ⟦{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧ and {丼物|どんぶりもの} (rice bowl dishes)

TYPES OF {葱|ねぎ}:
Usually made from the green part of {長葱|ながねぎ} (Japanese long onion) or {万能葱|ばんのうねぎ} (thin scallions). Sold pre-chopped at convenience stores and supermarkets.

OTHER COMMON {薬味|やくみ}:
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧: ginger
- ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧: shiso leaf
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧: bonito flakes
- ⟦{七味|しちみ}→七味：20131_shichimi⟧⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧: seven-spice chili powder
